description: B2B procurement quote ingestion, economies-of-scale asymptotic power-law price curve fitting, marginal cost curve regression, and hidden surcharge detection for enterprise buyers. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: fit_volume_price_elasticity_curve
